title: Supporting Small Businesses Across San Diego
description: Out in the community, supporting our small businesses…City staff, joined by Councilmembers, the Mayor’s Office and other partners, hit the streets regularly for business walks, connecting face-to-face with local owners, solving challenges together and sharing resources that help keep San Diego’s commercial corridors vibrant. When businesses thrive, our neighborhoods grow stronger — and we're here to support that success.
